name: DBQA
intro: DBQA 对应 LAB-Bench 的 DbQA 子集，包含 650 道程序化生成的生物数据库多选题，要求系统访问并推理不同版本数据库中的可溯源信息。
build_method: 数据库溯源, 程序化问题与干扰项生成
metric: 准确率, 精确率, 作答覆盖率
eval_feature: 10 个数据库检索子任务, 信息不足选项, 专家基线
scale: 650 题（固定官方划分：520 题公开、130 题私留；35% 是人类评测覆盖率）
build_method_en: Database Grounding, Programmatic Question and Distractor Generation
eval_feature_en: 10 Database-retrieval Subtasks, Insufficient-information Option, Expert Baseline
intro_en: DBQA corresponds to the DbQA subset of LAB-Bench: 650 programmatically generated multiple-choice questions that require access to and reasoning over attributable, versioned biological-database information.
scale_en: 650 questions (fixed official split: 520 public, 130 private; 35% is human-evaluation coverage)

drawio_review_note: Reviewed as LAB-Bench's DbQA subset against arXiv:2407.10362v3 and Future-House/LAB-Bench @ 998a8e0. The diagram preserves all 10 programmatic biology-database subtasks and the official fixed split of 520 public and 130 private questions. Table 1's 35% is human coverage and is not the public share. It also preserves source-version provenance, hard distractor construction, randomized choices including Insufficient information, zero-shot chain-of-thought with [ANSWER] tags, the paper parser's regex-first path and Claude 2 fallback, and accuracy/precision/coverage metrics.
